```go
func FindFolder(ctx context.Context, parentID, name string) (string, error) {
	svc, err := service(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	q := fmt.Sprintf(

```

```go
// lines 40-50
func ListFolder(ctx context.Context, folderID string) ([]Item, error) {
	svc, err := service(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	q := fmt.Sprintf("'%s' in parents and trashed = false", folderID)
```

```
Escape values interpolated into Google Drive API query strings

FindFolder and ListFolder built Drive `q` query literals with
fmt.Sprintf, embedding folder names/IDs directly inside single-quoted
segments with no escaping. A value containing a single quote or
backslash could break out of the literal and inject additional query
clauses. Added a shared escapeQueryValue helper (\ -> \\, ' -> \')
and applied it at both call sites.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
